desc: Ideation and selection of the primary O(DN) recurrence approach.
Implement the full solution: digit counts/sums, modular inverses/factorial, recurrence sweep for E_k and h_d,k, inverse-binomial accumulation, final combination, and N=1 edge case.
Verify the implementation on samples N=3, 390, 79223 and on small brute-force cases N<=8; fix any mismatches.
